description: Asks to invite a person to the workspace by email, as a member, or, with action, to send a waiting invitation again or cancel it. Only owners and admins can do this. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, CodeGene emails them the invitation (sending it again gives them a new link, and the earlier one stops working), or a cancelled invitation's link stops working.

action.description: invite (the default): invite them. resend: send their waiting invitation again. cancel: cancel their waiting invitation.

email.description: Their email address: the person to invite, or the address a waiting invitation went to.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: invite_member
title: Invite someone to the workspace
